audience: sales teams who manage contacts, leads and deals in Copper CRM

useCases.title: Review open deals and pipeline stages
useCases.text: The AI reads opportunities (deals) and the pipelines with their stages. It sorts and sums them up so you see where your deals stand.

useCases.title: Look up a person, company or lead
useCases.text: The AI searches people, companies and leads and reads one person's record in full. You get the contact details you need before a call.

useCases.title: Add a lead, or add or update a person
useCases.text: The AI creates a lead or a person from the details you give it, and can update fields of an existing person. Only the fields you provide are changed.

useCases.title: List open tasks and add a follow-up task
useCases.text: The AI searches tasks and shows what is open. It can create a new task, for example a follow-up for a deal.

useCases.title: Read the history of a record or log a call or note
useCases.text: The AI lists the notes, calls, meetings and system events attached to a record. It can also log a new activity on it.
